The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4eb3ab28f7565322), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 12-13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: For each N ≥ 1 and h ∈ IH there exists an admitted nearest-neighbor trajectory of depth N ending at h. Every sufficiently large bare coupling occurs in at least one such trajectory. There are fixed integers N0, M0 > 0, with M0 dyadic, such that every admitted trajectory with N ≥ N0, terminal coupling h ∈ IH, bare coupling β, and spacing a = L−N obeys 4 log Zβ(M0/a, M0/a) − log Zβ(2M0/a, 2M0/a) ≤ 2−10 , (3.1) m(β)/a ≤ log 8, (3.2) N log L = πβ − 1 2 log β + OL,H(1). (3.3) 12 In particular a ≍L,H √ βe−πβ. The error bound and the two preceding inequalities are uniform over these trajectories. The periodic plane limit is unique and has a positive full OS gap for every fixed β > 0.
